post.title: Building Resilient HTTP Clients in Node.js
post.brief: A practical walk through retries, backoff, and stale-while-revalidate caching for resilient outbound HTTP in Node services.

content.markdown: ## Why resilience matters Outbound HTTP is the most failure-prone part of a service. Wrap every call in a shared client that handles retries & backoff. - Retry only transient failures - Never retry 4xx - Serve a stale cache entry on total failure
content.text: Why resilience matters Outbound HTTP is the most failure-prone part of a service.
